name: kllm-bench-queries
description: A collection of benchmark queries intended to evaluate language model behavior and capabilities (e.g., factual knowledge, reasoning, instruction following) under the KLLM benchmarking setup. The dataset provides diverse prompts/queries used to probe and compare model outputs.
reputation: A community-contributed query set used in lightweight/academic LLM benchmarking; modest adoption within relevant GitHub/Hugging Face communities.
